headline: Nvidia Shares Rally 31% Following Jensen Huang's Reinstatement as CEO
summary: Nvidia shares surged 31% after the board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. US President Donald Trump stated he saw no security threat from Huang, while analysts note ongoing regulatory scrutiny and AI trade volatility.
why: Nvidia is a dominant designer of graphics processing units that power artificial intelligence workloads globally. Leadership stability and regulatory compliance directly impact its market valuation and the broader technology sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corp
impacts.why: The reinstatement of the CEO directly drove a 31% surge in Nvidia's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The return of co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO reassured investors following brief leadership uncertainty, sparking a strong relief rally in the stock.
